changelog.en: v1.1.5 build 24: after the portrait control bar auto-hides, entering fullscreen re-shows the controls instead of leaving the screen bare until the video is tapped.
changelog.tw: v1.1.5 build 24：直式控制條自動隱藏後進全螢幕，控制條會重新顯示，不用再點一下影片。
changelog.zh: v1.1.5 build 24：竖屏控制条自动隐藏后进全屏，控制条会重新显示，不用再点一下视频。
